messages.content:
Rewrite these unverified audio-model observations into non-speech captions
for Deaf/hard-of-hearing viewers. These observations are the ONLY factual input;
do not add sounds, source identities, emotion, visuals, plot or interpretations.
Do not treat observations as independently verified. Remove speculative causes
or moods. Preserve multiple audible sound types. Three texts per observation:
essential (short labels), balanced (brief description), detailed (more of the
already supplied acoustic detail, at most 25 words). All <= 278 characters, no
brackets, markup or newlines. If the observation explicitly reports no non-speech
sounds, return null texts for that id. Return only a JSON object with key captions,
an array of objects with EXACT keys id, essential, balanced, detailed. Preserve
every input id exactly once. Do not generate timestamps. Observations:
[{"id": "150", "observation": "A door creaks open, followed by footsteps on a hard surface and a metallic clank."}, {"id": "195", "observation": "A sustained, high-pitched electronic tone with a shimmering, breathy quality is audible, followed by a brief, low-pitched human vocalization."}, {"id": "225", "observation": "A sustained, low-frequency musical drone with a subtle, high-pitched shimmering effect is audible throughout the recording."}, {"id": "240", "observation": "A dramatic orchestral score plays, followed by a sharp metallic impact and a woman's urgent, high-pitched exclamation."}, {"id": "255", "observation": "A woman speaks, followed by a dog barking, a door opening, and a door closing."}, {"id": "300", "observation": "A high-pitched, sustained electronic tone plays over a background of crowd cheering and applause."}, {"id": "315", "observation": "A loud, metallic impact is followed by a deep, resonant rumble and a high-pitched, sustained electronic tone."}, {"id": "345", "observation": "A person walks on a hard surface, followed by a violin playing a melody."}]
